title: RH Lean Verification Atlas
description: This atlas records statements, proof steps and AI reviews so that readers can check Alpöge’s pinned Lean development step by step across successive editions. Paper v7, “Toward a human verification of Alpöge's Lean proof of the Riemann hypothesis, I: the conditional chain from Selmer windows to zero-free regions”, maps 775 statements and presents the conditional deduction. Blueprint v13b, “The Alpöge formalization of RH and GRH: an informal blueprint”, builds up the 20 original inputs. AI-written draft; AI cross-reviewed; no human review; not a claim that RH is proved.
notes: Text and data drafted by AI systems under the direction of the maintainer; no human review. Scripts under MIT.
